News Date : 15 Jun 2023News ReportDBS Selects 3 Students with a Lucrative Package of 9.07 LPAWe are thrilled to announce that three talented students from MGIT have been selected by DBS, a renowned multinational banking and financial services corporation. The selected students are:Linga Kavya (Roll Number: 19261A0584)Yallanki Uma (Roll Number: 19261A05C0)Eluri Jahnavi (Roll Number: 19261A0518)These students have secured prestigious positions at DBS with an impressive annual package of 9.07 lakhs per annum (LPA).This achievement highlights the exceptional skills and dedication of our students, reflecting the quality education and training provided by MGIT . We congratulate Linga Kavya (19261A0584), Yallanki Uma (19261A05C0), and Eluri Jahnavi (19261A0518) on this remarkable accomplishment and wish them continued success in their future endeavors.We are confident that their selection at DBS will open new doors of opportunity for them and serve as an inspiration for their peers. DBS Selects 3 Students with a Lucrative Package of 9.07 LPA
We are thrilled to announce that three talented students from MGIT have been selected by DBS, a renowned multinational banking and financial services corporation. The selected students are:
- Linga Kavya (Roll Number: 19261A0584)
- Yallanki Uma (Roll Number: 19261A05C0)
- Eluri Jahnavi (Roll Number: 19261A0518)
These students have secured prestigious positions at DBS with an impressive annual package of 9.07 lakhs per annum (LPA).
This achievement highlights the exceptional skills and dedication of our students, reflecting the quality education and training provided by MGIT . We congratulate Linga Kavya (19261A0584), Yallanki Uma (19261A05C0), and Eluri Jahnavi (19261A0518) on this remarkable accomplishment and wish them continued success in their future endeavors.
We are confident that their selection at DBS will open new doors of opportunity for them and serve as an inspiration for their peers. We extend our appreciation to the faculty members, mentors, and career guidance teams who have played a vital role in shaping the careers of these outstanding students.
Join us in celebrating this momentous occasion and stay tuned for more updates on the achievements of our talented students.
